name: AppVault
subtitle: App IPA and data backup utility
description: Browse installed applications and device folders using worse_query. Export readable app bundles as IPAs and data folders as ZIPs. Requires a provisioned App Group retained during signing. Access depends on path and OS; App Store executable encryption is preserved.
